title: CMO Ghaziabad Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 04 Ayurveda Medical Officer Posts
description: Chief Ayurveda Medical and Health Officer, Dantewada (CMO Ghaziabad) has declared the latest job notification for the recruitment of 04 Ayurveda Medical Officer Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in BAMS or BHMS can grab this chance and apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply offline before the last date. Here we mention more details about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for the CMO Ghaziabad...
